emailSubject: FMB News | PAGASA: LPA 08F Cyclone Risk Raised to High as Monsoon Inundates Luzon & Visayas | August 18, 2026 | 7:00 AM PHT
headline: PAGASA Raises LPA 08F Cyclone Potential to High as Another LPA Forms
seoTitle: PAGASA: LPA 08F Cyclone Potential Raised to High | FMB News
seoDescription: The approved FMB News morning brief reports that PAGASA raised LPA 08F's cyclone-development potential to high while monitoring another disturbance outside PAR.
deck: The developing systems are being watched for their effect on the Southwest Monsoon and flood risk across western Luzon.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The approved FMB News 7:00 AM package, citing PAGASA, reports that Low Pressure Area 08F was assessed as having a high chance of developing into a tropical depression within 24 hours.
The same package reports a second disturbance, LPA 08G, outside the Philippine Area of Responsibility with a medium development potential.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The briefing says the disturbances were helping sustain an enhanced Southwest Monsoon, with heavy-rain warnings affecting parts of western and northern Luzon. At this stage, LPA 08F was still an LPA and had not yet been declared a named tropical depression.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Cyclone development can change rainfall, marine and flood risks even before a system makes landfall or is assigned a domestic name.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch PAGASA bulletins for formal cyclone classification, track guidance, rainfall warnings and marine advisories.
